description:
Morning Motivation | Sitar Instrumental | 1.5 Hours

Start the day with drive, not dread.

No coffee-jolt, no doomscroll, no hype-track to fake the energy. Just a clear, bright sound that wakes the mind up gently and points it forward — steady enough to think, warm enough to feel, energizing enough to actually get moving.

This is 90 minutes of Sitar in Raga Bilawal — a classic bright, cheerful morning raga built entirely on natural, open notes, so it lifts without tension. The Sitar leads with warm plucked melody and gentle glissando slides over a soft rolling tabla and a low tanpura drone. Tuned to 432Hz with a light Alpha-wave layer underneath to keep the mind alert but unhurried.

Put it on while you make coffee, plan the day, journal, stretch, or ease into focused work. Let the momentum build on its own.

WHAT YOU'LL HEAR
• Bright, uplifting Sitar melody in Raga Bilawal
• Soft, rolling tabla keeping a gentle forward pulse
• Warm tanpura drone underneath
• 90 minutes, seamless — no jarring breaks

BEST FOR
• Slow productive mornings
• Planning, journaling, or easing into work
• A lift without the caffeine crash

Subscribe to Raga Focus for more Indian classical music for focus, calm, and better mornings.
thumbnail_prompt: Pichwai/Kangra miniature painting style, ornate warm-gold and saffron patterned border with morning sun, lotus and songbird motifs, aged warm parchment background, bright dawn palette (warm saffron, amber gold, soft peach, aged cream, a hint of pale dawn blue). Central figure: an upright, alert musician in cream-and-saffron attire seated cross-legged playing the sitar (long-necked fretted lute with a large round gourd resonator, held at an upward angle, plucked with the right hand), in an open-air sunlit courtyard at early morning. Clear golden side-light, crisp fresh air, a single blooming lotus and a songbird mid-flight to signal a day beginning with energy. Mood: bright, awake, forward-moving — NOT sleepy or meditative. Dark-teal serif text overlay reading 'START STRONG', clean and bold, lower third, mobile-readable at grid size. No clutter.

production_spec.loop_seam: 10s in / 30s out, Suno extend 3-4x → loop in post to fill 90 min
production_spec.notes: Raga Bilawal — the shuddha (all-natural-note) parent scale, classic morning raga, bright and cheerful with no tension. Sitar leads with light tabla (Sitar performance rule — every high-performing Sitar ship had tabla; the only no-tabla Sitar was the lowest). Keep tempo brisk-but-calm (85-92 BPM) — motivation/energy, not frantic. Binaural Alpha 10Hz layer added in POST only (kept out of the Suno prompt per standing rule).
